description: Source code for Bluetooth Audio BAP ISO handling, including ISO object management, reference counting, configuration, and endpoint binding.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new bt_bap_iso object from the pool.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_ref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a bt_bap_iso object.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_unref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a bt_bap_iso object.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all bt_bap_iso objects, applying a callback function.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_find
methods.description: Finds a bt_bap_iso object matching a condition via callback.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_init
methods.description: Initializes a bt_bap_iso object with channel operations.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_configure_data_path
methods.description: Configures data path parameters for an endpoint.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_bind_ep
methods.description: Binds an endpoint to an ISO object.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_unbind_ep
methods.description: Unbinds an endpoint from an ISO object.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_get_ep
methods.description: Retrieves the endpoint associated with an ISO object for a given direction.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_get_paired_ep
methods.description: Retrieves the paired endpoint of a given endpoint.

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_bind_stream
methods.description: Binds a stream to an ISO object (unicast client only).

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_unbind_stream
methods.description: Unbinds a stream from an ISO object (unicast client only).

methods.name: bt_bap_iso_get_stream
methods.description: Retrieves the stream associated with an ISO object for a given direction (unicast client only).
